title: Amyloidosis register ACCB
summary: The aim of the project is to follow up patients with diagnosed amyloidosis regardless of the precursor protein. The recorded data includes clinical, diagnostic and therapeutic aspects that are collected as part of regular medical work by different disciplines of the ACCB (e.g. neurology, cardiology, nephrology, hematology). In the long term, patient treatment should be improved through early diagnosis, standardized monitoring of markers of disease activity, early initiation of therapy and therapy monitoring.

interventions.name: In addition to standardized, subject-specific clinical methods (e.g. general anamnesis, internal/cardiological examination, neurological assessment (NIS), ophthalmological examination), the assessment of patients also includes patient-reported outcomes (PRO).
